data.standardized_narrative: The report does not disclose a single explicit gross prior-year reserve movement figure. Opening gross claims reserves at 1 January 2020 were GBP 1,123.995m. The Syndicate notes adverse development on prior years (the 2019 year was impacted by higher than expected losses on prior years of account) driven historically by natural catastrophe and large loss development (notably catastrophe activity in 2016-2018). The 2020 result was dominated by a large COVID-19 related loss (GBP 152.7m net) and additional 2020 natural catastrophe losses (Derecho storms and Hurricane Laura). No clear gross prior-year reserve movement (gross PYD) line is reported in the financial statements; gross PYD could not be reliably extracted from the available disclosures.

data.data_quality_notes: No explicit gross prior-year movement (gross PYD) figure is provided in the 'Movement in prior year's provision' format. Narrative amounts given in the report are net of reinsurance. A gross claims development triangle is present and transcribed but rows are staggered (development periods have different column lengths); extraction of a definitive gross PYD from the triangle would require careful diagonal comparisons and is not provided here. Where the report gives explicit amounts for catastrophes these are presented as net amounts in the text; therefore no reliable single gross PYD number could be produced from the available disclosures. Claims development triangle values are recorded in thousands as presented in the report.
